subject: Velvet Brew
prompt: Create a rich, playful coffee shop website for a brand called Velvet Brew. Include navigation, hero, featured drinks, menu, our story, testimonials, gallery, visit section and footer. Make it warm, colorful, handcrafted and visually rich. Avoid a sleek corporate or overly modern look.
strategy: Expressive display/sans, warm contrast with colorful accents, image-led split, drink feature rail, dense menu, story, quote emphasis and gallery.
avoid: Sleek corporate template or a page of equal card grids.

subject: Independent art director
prompt: Create a portfolio website for an independent art director. Include intro, selected work, short profile, client list and contact. Make it editorial, typography-led and slightly unconventional. Use strong scale changes and avoid dashboard-style cards.
strategy: Oversized typographic intro, asymmetrical selected-work spread, narrow profile, typographic client list, strong contact line and restrained surfaces.
avoid: Dashboard cards or fabricated real client endorsements.

subject: Small logistics company
prompt: Create a desktop dashboard for a small logistics company. Include sidebar, shipment status overview, active deliveries, exceptions, recent activity and quick actions. Make it practical, information-dense and easy to scan. Avoid decorative marketing-page styling.
strategy: Compact application shell, data-first overview, delivery table, grouped exceptions/activity and clear quick actions; restrained type and operational colors.
avoid: Giant marketing hero, decorative metrics or invented live operations.

subject: Geography learning app
prompt: Create a desktop learning app for children practicing geography. Include navigation, current challenge, progress, topic cards and recent achievements. Make it playful and friendly without making the interface chaotic.
strategy: Friendly expressive type, controlled bright roles, one dominant challenge, subordinate progress, topic choices and compact achievement rail.
avoid: Chaotic rainbow decoration or invented demographic assumptions.

subject: Internal inventory
prompt: Create an internal inventory management screen. Include navigation, search, filters, inventory table, stock warnings and bulk actions. Keep it restrained, utilitarian and compact.
strategy: Compact operational toolbar, search/filter hierarchy, dense readable table, selected-row bulk actions and stock warnings near affected data.
avoid: Promotional hero, testimonials or unnecessary decorative sections.
